pos.personaBrief: Milan built around Pirlo as regista and aimed at dominance of central areas (possession fact), with Gattuso and Ambrosini protecting him; not a reactive counter side, though it hit on the break with Kaka.

pro.personaBrief: Pirlo dropped between centre-backs to build, but Kaka and Inzaghi attacked quickly with long passes forward; a mixed profile favouring a creative regista over a safe holder.

est.personaBrief: Sempremilan notes the midfield four played on zonal principles with freedom and Kaka had a license to roam, so a fluid, relational 4-3-2-1 with positional switches (Seedorf dropping with Gattuso).

lar.personaBrief: The Christmas tree lacks natural width (Coaches' Voice); play went through the central trio and Kaka, with full-backs crossing only occasionally from Pirlo's passes.

blo.personaBrief: Milan pressed selectively, with forwards and midfielders jumping onto defenders against United, but at 2007 intensity and an older squad, with no evidence of gegenpressing or a deep block.

mar.personaBrief: Sources conflict: man-marking while pressing United and Ronaldo doubled by Oddo and Gattuso, yet midfielders worked on zonal principles; Italian zonal defending leans toward space protection with selective dedicated markers.

pla.personaBrief: Ancelotti kept his 4-3-2-1 but tweaked it for Manchester United (Seedorf dropping, doubling Ronaldo), adapting details around a stable identity and adjusting at the break.

res.personaBrief: A pragmatic winner of the Champions League, a team Ancelotti called technically inferior to 2005; it eased off in the group and chose the stats-based option for the final, results first.

sis.personaBrief: A star-based side (Kaka licensed to roam, Pirlo, Seedorf) with collective duties, and Ancelotti known for managing talent rather than imposing a rigid system.

jog.personaBrief: Pirlo as technical regista and Seedorf/Kaka as creators, with Gattuso as the engine; technique valued over pure strength, while Milan Lab kept physical fitness high.

bas.personaBrief: The oldest Champions League final team ever (Maldini 37, Inzaghi 33, only Kaka under 30 among key men), with the Milan Lab prolonging veteran careers.

lid.personaBrief: Kaka calls Ancelotti's ability to manage people his best quality; a harmony-first, listening coach, though rules apply to all in a veteran dressing room.
